name: AR-110
description:
## Description

"Armless record player with mechanical floating system.The floating system is composed mainly of springs and a combination of elastic cushioning materials with different vibration coefficients. The suspension is tuned for both sound quality and ease of use. The drive motor is separated from the floating deck to prevent motor vibration from being transmitted.In addition, the three point support floating deck has a black matte finish made of thick aluminum alloys, and a Rusk vibration absorbing material is installed on the back of the deck just below the armboard to reduce vibrations from the outside.The turntable is made of aluminum alloy with a diameter of 30cm and weight of 3.2kg. The turntable and the shaft with a diameter of 15mm are polished together after fitting to ensure accurate horizontal and vertical positioning. In addition, the shaft and bearing are long enough to prevent rattling and loosening of the turntable. The bearing oil is a special synthetic lubricating oil that does not change viscosity due to fundamental sound.A heavy wood ring is built into the back of the turntable to improve the moment of inertia and to suppress the metallic sound caused by the turntable squeal.Newly developed original high conductivity felt mat is used for the turntable seat.The original mat with a thickness of 5mm provides a high antistatic effect and reduces scratch noise by suppressing the generation of static electricity.The drive system uses a belt drive system, and the drive belt uses a neoprene belt.This belt is polished on 4sides, front and back, both sides.A DC servo motor is used as the drive motor.The motor section absorbs microvibration caused by rotation through a damper material.A special order transformer with less leakage is used for the power supply.Equipped with strobe, speed fine adjustment of + 12% to -6% is possible.The cabinet has a monocoque structure, especially with a 35mm thick bottom plate, and a flat bottom can be obtained by removing the four legs.You can adjust the level of the deck by turning 3screws from right above the board.AR-110has been considered for use with Rusk vibration absorbers from the design stage, and a wide contact surface can be secured.The Rusk insulator uses a special gray cast iron with a large damping capacity to provide high vibration absorption and sound absorption. The I-5040mkII is the best choice for the AR 110."

name: AC-03
description:
## Description

"MC stereo cartridge that uses super Hi - Ï‰ core material.Uses PC-S, a super Hi - Ï‰ core material.PC (78% Permalloy) with excellent magnetic characteristics has a problem of magnetic saturation in a strong magnetic field, so it was impossible to use it in a magnetic circuit such as MC cartridge. Therefore, we focused on improving the performance of Hi - Ï‰ ? PC material, which has been proven for many years, and developed super Hi - Ï‰ core material PC-S by carefully repeating basic experiments and concentrating experience.Compared with conventional PCs, this PC-S exhibits superior characteristics in both initial permeability, which indicates magnetization response, and coercive force, which indicates residual magnetization. In addition to less hysteresis loss and magnetic distortion, effective permeability in the high-frequency range, which is important for reproducing the subtle nuance of sound, is significantly improved.Neodymium magnet with excellent crystal magnetic anisotropy is used for permanent magnet of magnetic circuit.The neodymium magnet has a very large BHmax and can obtain a strong magnetic flux density even in a small size. In addition, soft iron yoke materials with high permeability and excellent saturation magnetic characteristics are ideally placed in front and back of the magnet. Since the leakage magnetic flux to the outside of the cartridge is small and strong DC magnetic field can be obtained, the output level of 0.3mV or more at 3� is secured.Aluminum alloy pipe material is used for the cantilever.The double structure of the main and outer parts of this pipe reduces the effective mass while increasing the strength.3x30Ï‰ m semi-line contact stylus shape is adopted for the needle tip, and excellent tracing capability is obtained as well as weight reduction of the moving mass.The cartridge body and external housing are made of lightweight and strong aluminum alloy.It is designed with consideration for the robustness of the base part and dustproof measures of the housing."

name: AUDIO
description:
## Description

"MC Mono cartridge designed as a mono only version of AC 03.When a monaural disc is played back with a stereo cartridge, the vertical vibration component, which is a characteristic of stereo recording, is picked up, and the sound clarity is reasonable.The AC 03mono not only meets the requirements for mono playback, but also pursues sound quality.The basic design philosophy and materials are based on AC 03. However, in order to realize the original monaural reproduction, the generator coil is arranged only for the horizontal signal and does not have sensitivity in the vertical direction. However, the vibration system has compliance in all directions, so it can handle records under any condition."

name: AUDIO
description:
## Description

"This phono equalizer amplifier was developed with further consideration while inheriting the concept of the PE 6000Signature.The basic design follows the circuit connection method inherited from the PE 6000Signature and uses many similar parts.In place of the Vichea K &ΩS series, DALE'Ωs CMF metal film resistor is used for the circuit resistor, which accounts for the largest part of the cost.The circuit configuration uses an NF type equalizer amplifier with two stages of resistance load differential amplifier.The SEPP output balance circuit incorporated in both sides of the second stage output introduced in the PE 6000Signature has been changed to the SEPP circuit of one side sy passing force in the PE 5500.A stable DC power supply is supplied to the circuit board of the equalizer circuit from the regulator circuit individually for the left and right sides.Taking advantage of the through-hole circuit board, we have adopted a single-pole concentrated palace system and earth pocket warmers, which are highly evaluated in terms of sound quality.The equalizer gain is set to MM42dB.There are two MM input terminals, which can be switched by the rear panel selector.Attaching the I/O connector directly to the chassis can result in loss of signal energy and degraded sound quality. This is due to the influence of the power transformer and power supply circuit. Irregular stray current always flows through the chassis and affects the input and output of signals.The PE 5500uses an insulating terminal board in the connector section to protect the input / output circuit of the signal from harmful stray current flowing through the chassis.The power transformer and rectifier circuit of the power supply section are enclosed in a shield box of 2.3mm thickness and floating mounted on the main chassis.This protects the equalizer circuit board from the electromagnetic induction of the transformer and broadband spike noise of the rectifier.The power cable tour uses a 3-pole AC inlet system in accordance with IEC standards, and various power cables can be replaced."
